body.title: Implement scanOrphansWith/killOrphansWith + the scanOrphans/killOrphans facade methods
body.summary: In src/cli/services/debug.ts add injectable-deps helpers: scanOrphansWith(deps) (deps: ps-runner, platform, managedPid, daemonEntry) runs the ps scan, matches the resolved DAEMON_ENTRY, excludes the managed pid, returns {supported:false} on win32, and folds any ps failure into {supported:true; orphans:[]}; killOrphansWith(deps) (deps: kill(pid,signal), isAlive/liveness probe, wait/clock, platform, managedPid) does SIGTERM -> wait ~3s -> SIGKILL-only-for-survivors over exactly the passed pids, re-excludes the managed pid, folds signal errors into per-pid KillOutcome, no-ops off-POSIX, never throws. Add zero-arg wrappers scanOrphans()/killOrphans(pids) over realDeps (DAEMON_ENTRY, pidFromFile, execFileSync ps, process.kill, process.platform), add the two methods to the DebugService interface, and bind them onto the makeServices() debug entry. Build note: land WITH t5 (the fakes) in one increment.
acceptanceChecks: DebugService interface gains scanOrphans(): OrphanScanResult + killOrphans(pids: readonly number[]): Promise<KillOutcome[]>; existing members unchanged
scanOrphansWith returns non-managed daemon-entry pids from canned ps output; {supported:false} on win32; {supported:true;orphans:[]} on ps failure
killOrphansWith sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL only to survivors (injected clock), acts only on the passed pids, re-excludes the managed pid, folds errors into per-pid KillOutcome, never throws
makeServices().debug.scanOrphans + .killOrphans are bound to the real impls; tsc compiles
no real ps/process.kill runs in the unit tests (deps injected)

tests.name: scanOrphansWith: canned ps output (daemon-entry + managed-pid + unrelated node) -> {supported:true} with ONLY the non-managed daemon-entry pid(s)
scanOrphansWith: platform 'win32' -> {supported:false} with no ps invoked
scanOrphansWith: managed pid undefined -> every matching daemon-entry process is a candidate
killOrphansWith([p]) p dies on SIGTERM -> (p,'SIGTERM') then liveness clears; 'terminated', no SIGKILL
killOrphansWith([p]) p survives -> (p,'SIGTERM') then after injected wait (p,'SIGKILL'); 'forced'
killOrphansWith([managedPid,p]) -> managed pid never signalled; only p processed
killOrphansWith([p]) kill throws EPERM/ESRCH -> 'error'/'not-found', no re-throw, other pids still processed
killOrphansWith([]) -> no kill calls, resolves []; off-POSIX -> no-op
makeServices().debug exposes scanOrphans + killOrphans bound to the real impls
